title: camelina alyssum subsp. integerrima
intro: Camelina alyssum subsp. integerrima, commonly known as Wild Goldenseal or Wild Turnip, is a subspecies of the Camelina alyssum plant, a flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Wild Goldenseal include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, glucosinolates, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
